integrity: Derivation and exact exhaustive certificate checked; floating-point hull experiments are corroborative, not an exhaustive or infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp tree-maximizer classification is proved only for 2 through 7 vertices. The matching-polynomial primal volume and order-polytope volume are established prior results. Equivalence to earlier unpublished or alternatively termed graph Mahler tables cannot be excluded.
title: The seven-vertex extremal transition for Mahler products of type-B tree-root polytopes
